s0201.literal: The dog-relay stations and ox-relay stations under Liaoyang Province were merged into one, and paper money was still granted to relieve their shortage.
s0201.idiomatic: The dog-relay stations and ox-relay stations under Liaoyang Province were merged into one, and paper money was still granted to relieve their shortage.

s0202.literal: The province and the censorate were ordered to dispatch officials together with Sibaqa to try those responsible for the delay in transport of grain to Karakorum that had not yet arrived.
s0202.idiomatic: The province and the censorate were ordered to dispatch officials together with Sibaqa to try those responsible for the delay in transport of grain to Karakorum that had not yet arrived.

s0203.literal: Pingji County in Zhending Route suffered drought.
s0203.idiomatic: Pingji County in Zhending Route suffered drought.

s0204.literal: Twelfth month, guiyou day: censorate officials said, "The officials impeached and the relevant offices try the case together, whereby matters are obstructed and hard to carry out; we ask to follow the former regulations.
s0204.idiomatic: Twelfth month, guiyou day: censorate officials said, "The officials impeached and the relevant offices try the case together, whereby matters are obstructed and hard to carry out; we ask to follow the former regulations.

s0205.literal: Whenever the central secretariat has any reform, investigating censors are invariably sent along; this is not appropriate; from now on they should not be sent unless by imperial order.
s0205.idiomatic: Whenever the central secretariat has any reform, investigating censors are invariably sent along; this is not appropriate; from now on they should not be sent unless by imperial order.

s0207.literal: On gengyin day Mars transgressed Xuan Yuan.
s0207.idiomatic: On gengyin day Mars transgressed Xuan Yuan.

s0208.literal: On guisi day the Moon transgressed the angular star of Fang.
s0208.idiomatic: On guisi day the Moon transgressed the angular star of Fang.

s0209.literal: The Jin Prefecture darughachi Negu Bor feigned his mother's death and returned to fetch his wife.
s0209.idiomatic: The Jin Prefecture darughachi Negu Bor feigned his mother's death and returned to fetch his wife.

s0210.literal: When the matter was reported, an edict said that because he had debased and injured the moral order, he was dismissed from office and not reappointed.
s0210.idiomatic: When the matter was reported, an edict said that because he had debased and injured the moral order, he was dismissed from office and not reappointed.

s0211.literal: Liu Shen, Heladai, and Zheng You were sent to command twenty thousand troops to campaign against Babai Xifu; the Yunnan provincial government was also ordered to grant five horses per ten soldiers, and when insufficient, cattle were supplied to make up the difference.
s0211.idiomatic: Liu Shen, Heladai, and Zheng You were sent to command 20,000 troops to campaign against Babai Xifu; the Yunnan provincial government was also ordered to grant five horses per ten soldiers, and when insufficient, cattle were supplied to make up the difference.

s0212.literal: Prince Xindu's households were granted fifty thousand ingots of paper money, the four households of Ulus Buqa and others two hundred nineteen thousand-odd ingots, and the Western Capital garrison troops twenty-eight thousand-odd ingots.
s0212.idiomatic: Prince Xindu's households were granted 50,000 ingots of paper money, the four households of Ulus Buqa and others 219,000-odd ingots, and the Western Capital garrison troops 28,000-odd ingots.

s0213.literal: Two hundred twenty-nine thousand three hundred-odd shi of grain was distributed in relief to famine victims at Jiankang, Pingjiang, Eastern Zhejiang, and other places.
s0213.idiomatic: 229,300-odd shi of grain was distributed in relief to famine victims at Jiankang, Pingjiang, Eastern Zhejiang, and other places.

s0214.literal: Year 5, spring, first month, jiyou day: the Moon transgressed the Five Chariots.
s0214.idiomatic: Year 5, spring, first month, jiyou day: the Moon transgressed the Five Chariots.

s0215.literal: On gengxu day paper money was granted to the army campaigning against Babai Xifu, totaling more than ninety-two thousand ingots.
s0215.idiomatic: On gengxu day paper money was granted to the army campaigning against Babai Xifu, totaling more than 92,000 ingots.

s0216.literal: On renzi day the Moon transgressed Ghost Accumulated Corpse Qi.
s0216.idiomatic: On renzi day the Moon transgressed Ghost Accumulated Corpse Qi.

s0217.literal: The imperial portrait of Empress Zhaorui Shunsheng was installed at Huguo Renwang Monastery.
s0217.idiomatic: The imperial portrait of Empress Zhaorui Shunsheng was installed at Huguo Renwang Monastery.

s0218.literal: The gold-mining and iron-smelting intendancies of Tan and Jing prefectures were abolished, and their affairs were placed under the capital intendancy.
s0218.idiomatic: The gold-mining and iron-smelting intendancies of Tan and Jing prefectures were abolished, and their affairs were placed under the capital intendancy.

s0219.literal: Censorate officials said, "Officials who commit corruption or steal government funds, and upon exposure flee to escape punishment, should be treated the same as if the case were concluded.
s0219.idiomatic: Censorate officials said, "Officials who commit corruption or steal government funds, and upon exposure flee to escape punishment, should be treated the same as if the case were concluded.

s0220.literal: Even if pardoned, demotion and dismissal should still be added, so that deceit and fraud may be reformed.
s0220.idiomatic: Even if pardoned, demotion and dismissal should still be added, so that deceit and fraud may be reformed.

s0222.literal: On bingyin day, because the salt laws of the Two Huai were stagnating, two transport commission officials were ordered to divide duties on the upper river to rectify them; seals and courier passes were also issued.
s0222.idiomatic: On bingyin day, because the salt laws of the Two Huai were stagnating, two transport commission officials were ordered to divide duties on the upper river to rectify them; seals and courier passes were also issued.

s0223.literal: On xinyou day the Moon transgressed Heart.
s0223.idiomatic: On xinyou day the Moon transgressed Heart.

s0224.literal: Second month, jimao day: the Moon transgressed Ghost.
s0224.idiomatic: Second month, jimao day: the Moon transgressed Ghost.

s0225.literal: Liu Shen and Heladai were both made right vice chancellor of the central secretariat, and Zheng You was made vice director of the secretariat; all wore tiger tallies.
s0225.idiomatic: Liu Shen and Heladai were both made right vice chancellor of the central secretariat, and Zheng You was made vice director of the secretariat; all wore tiger tallies.

s0226.literal: Branch central secretariat affairs of the various routes in Yunnan were divided; two judicial inquest officials were established, one director, one vice director, and one registrar each, and four round tallies and twenty courier passes were granted.
s0226.idiomatic: Branch central secretariat affairs of the various routes in Yunnan were divided; two judicial inquest officials were established, one director, one vice director, and one registrar each, and four round tallies and 20 courier passes were granted.

s0227.literal: The Fujian weaving and embroidery intendancy was abolished.
s0227.idiomatic: The Fujian weaving and embroidery intendancy was abolished.

s0228.literal: Hejian Transport Commission salt was increased to two hundred eighty thousand yin; its subordinate salt offices at Qing, Cang, and Shen were abolished.
s0228.idiomatic: Hejian Transport Commission salt was increased to 280,000 yin; its subordinate salt offices at Qing, Cang, and Shen were abolished.

s0229.literal: On dinghai day two ten-thousand-household offices for the campaign against Babai Xifu were established, with four commanders of ten thousand households; convicts from Sichuan and Yunnan were sent to join the army.
s0229.idiomatic: On dinghai day two ten-thousand-household offices for the campaign against Babai Xifu were established, with four commanders of ten thousand households; convicts from Sichuan and Yunnan were sent to join the army.

s0230.literal: On yiwei day an edict said that surveillance commission officials, except for mourning a parent, moving a grave, or taking sick leave, must not leave their posts;
s0230.idiomatic: On yiwei day an edict said that surveillance commission officials, except for mourning a parent, moving a grave, or taking sick leave, must not leave their posts;

s0231.literal: those who received appointment but did not take up their posts because the place was far or the office was low-ranking should not be employed again by the censorate.
s0231.idiomatic: those who received appointment but did not take up their posts because the place was far or the office was low-ranking should not be employed again by the censorate.

s0232.literal: On bingshen day ten thousand horses were granted to Toghto's households and others.
s0232.idiomatic: On bingshen day 10,000 horses were granted to Toghto's households and others.

s0233.literal: On dingyou day the imperial carriage arrived at Shangdu.
s0233.idiomatic: On dingyou day the imperial carriage arrived at Shangdu.

s0234.literal: An edict ordered the Yunnan branch central secretariat to reduce officials of internal and external offices by one thousand five hundred fourteen, and to increase garrison troops in Jiangsu and Zhejiang.
s0234.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Yunnan branch central secretariat to reduce officials of internal and external offices by 1,514, and to increase garrison troops in Jiangsu and Zhejiang.

s0235.literal: On wuxu day Zhao'ying Palace and Xingjiao Monastery were each granted one hundred qing of land; Xingjiao was additionally granted fifteen thousand ingots of paper money;
s0235.idiomatic: On wuxu day Zhao'ying Palace and Xingjiao Monastery were each granted 100 qing of land; Xingjiao was additionally granted 15,000 ingots of paper money;

s0236.literal: Shangdu Qianyuan Monastery was granted ninety qing of land, with paper money in the same amount as Xingjiao;
s0236.idiomatic: Shangdu Qianyuan Monastery was granted 90 qing of land, with paper money in the same amount as Xingjiao;

s0237.literal: Wan'an Monastery six hundred qing of land and ten thousand ingots;
s0237.idiomatic: Wan'an Monastery 600 qing of land and 10,000 ingots;

s0238.literal: Nan Monastery one hundred twenty qing of land, with paper money equal to Wan'an's amount.
s0238.idiomatic: Nan Monastery 120 qing of land, with paper money equal to Wan'an's amount.

s0239.literal: On jihai day, for all soldiers who commit murder, rape, or robbery, military and civilian officials were ordered to try the cases together.
s0239.idiomatic: On jihai day, for all soldiers who commit murder, rape, or robbery, military and civilian officials were ordered to try the cases together.

s0240.literal: Xiong Cuo, route administrator of Yongning Route, came to court, presented more than thirty horses, and was granted silks and cloth in varying amounts.
s0240.idiomatic: Xiong Cuo, route administrator of Yongning Route, came to court, presented more than 30 horses, and was granted silks and cloth in varying amounts.

s0241.literal: Third month, jiachen day: former military officers' gold and silver tallies were collected.
s0241.idiomatic: Third month, jiachen day: former military officers' gold and silver tallies were collected.

s0242.literal: On wushen day the Moon transgressed Maid.
s0242.idiomatic: On wushen day the Moon transgressed Maid.

s0243.literal: On jiyou day the Shaanxi Route monopoly tax office was abolished.
s0243.idiomatic: On jiyou day the Shaanxi Route monopoly tax office was abolished.

s0244.literal: On renzi day Prince Yesun and others were granted eighteen thousand five hundred ingots of paper money.
s0244.idiomatic: On renzi day Prince Yesun and others were granted 18,500 ingots of paper money.

s0245.literal: On wuwu day envoys from the islands of Malaihu and others came to court and were granted gold brocade in varying amounts.
s0245.idiomatic: On wuwu day envoys from the islands of Malaihu and others came to court and were granted gold brocade in varying amounts.

s0246.literal: Two hundred thousand ingots of paper money were granted to impoverished troops at Karakorum, and fifteen thousand nine hundred-odd ingots to Prince Yaomuhu'er's households.
s0246.idiomatic: 200,000 ingots of paper money were granted to impoverished troops at Karakorum, and 15,900-odd ingots to Prince Yaomuhu'er's households.

s0247.literal: On dingmao day Mars transgressed Earth Star.
s0247.idiomatic: On dingmao day Mars transgressed Earth Star.

s0248.literal: On jisi day Mars and Earth Star came into conjunction.
s0248.idiomatic: On jisi day Mars and Earth Star came into conjunction.

s0249.literal: An edict admonished and rectified officials within and without the court.
s0249.idiomatic: An edict admonished and rectified officials within and without the court.

s0250.literal: Shalan, branch secretariat grand councillor of Liaoyang, was ordered to command ten thousand men to garrison at Xiashanhou, each man to keep two horses, with the price paid by the government.
s0250.idiomatic: Shalan, branch secretariat grand councillor of Liaoyang, was ordered to command 10,000 men to garrison at Xiashanhou, each man to keep two horses, with the price paid by the government.

s0251.literal: Summer, fourth month, renshen day: the Moon transgressed Eastern Well.
s0251.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, renshen day: the Moon transgressed Eastern Well.

s0252.literal: On guiyou day Tula Timur and others were sent to reward the Karakorum army.
s0252.idiomatic: On guiyou day Tula Timur and others were sent to reward the Karakorum army.

s0253.literal: On renwu day, because Prince of Jin Gammala's households were impoverished, four hundred thousand ingots of paper money were granted.
s0253.idiomatic: On renwu day, because Prince of Jin Gammala's households were impoverished, 400,000 ingots of paper money were granted.

s0254.literal: Yunnan troops were mobilized to campaign against Babai Xifu.
s0254.idiomatic: Yunnan troops were mobilized to campaign against Babai Xifu.

s0255.literal: On guisi day wine-brewing at Karakorum was forbidden; princes and imperial sons-in-law were permitted to brew for their own consumption, but not to sell.
s0255.idiomatic: On guisi day wine-brewing at Karakorum was forbidden; princes and imperial sons-in-law were permitted to brew for their own consumption, but not to sell.

s0256.literal: This month, bugs ate mulberry trees at Dadu, Zhangde, Guangping, Zhending, Shunde, Daming, and Puzhou.
s0256.idiomatic: This month, bugs ate mulberry trees at Dadu, Zhangde, Guangping, Zhending, Shunde, Daming, and Puzhou.

s0257.literal: Fifth month: falling frost at Shangzhou killed the wheat.
s0257.idiomatic: Fifth month: falling frost at Shangzhou killed the wheat.

s0258.literal: The demonic rebels Chousi and others in Henan were executed.
s0258.idiomatic: The demonic rebels Chousi and others in Henan were executed.

s0259.literal: On jiyou day eighty-eight thousand seven hundred-odd ingots of paper money were granted to Yue Li Ke Li's army garrisoning at Xiashanhou to purchase horses.
s0259.idiomatic: On jiyou day 88,700-odd ingots of paper money were granted to Yue Li Ke Li's army garrisoning at Xiashanhou to purchase horses.

s0260.literal: On xinhai day Kielie Yidai Toghto was sent to lead troops to campaign in Sichuan.
s0260.idiomatic: On xinhai day Kielie Yidai Toghto was sent to lead troops to campaign in Sichuan.

s0261.literal: On guichou day the Moon transgressed Southern Dipper.
s0261.idiomatic: On guichou day the Moon transgressed Southern Dipper.

s0262.literal: On yimao day Mars transgressed Right Enforcer.
s0262.idiomatic: On yimao day Mars transgressed Right Enforcer.

s0263.literal: On bingchen day Hulinsi, pacification commissioner of Qujing and other routes and concurrently commander of ten thousand households, came to court.
s0263.idiomatic: On bingchen day Hulinsi, pacification commissioner of Qujing and other routes and concurrently commander of ten thousand households, came to court.

s0264.literal: On renxu day the native official Song Longji of Yunnan rebelled.
s0264.idiomatic: On renxu day the native official Song Longji of Yunnan rebelled.

s0265.literal: At that time Liu Shen was leading troops into Yunnan by way of Shunyuan; Yue Hunan, right vice director of Yunnan, mobilized the people to supply provisions; Longji thereupon deceived his followers, saying, "The government army has conscripted you; they will cut all your hair and tattoo your faces to make soldiers; you will die on the battlefield and your wives and children will be taken captive.
s0265.idiomatic: At that time Liu Shen was leading troops into Yunnan by way of Shunyuan; Yue Hunan, right vice director of Yunnan, mobilized the people to supply provisions; Longji thereupon deceived his followers, saying, "The government army has conscripted you; they will cut all your hair and tattoo your faces to make soldiers; you will die on the battlefield and your wives and children will be taken captive.

s0266.literal: The crowd was swayed by his words and thereupon rebelled.
s0266.idiomatic: The crowd was swayed by his words and thereupon rebelled.

s0267.literal: On bingyin day an edict said that two thousand volunteers from Yunnan Province campaigning against Babai Xifu would each be given sixty strings of cowrie shells.
s0267.idiomatic: On bingyin day an edict said that 2,000 volunteers from Yunnan Province campaigning against Babai Xifu would each be given 60 strings of cowrie shells.

s0268.literal: On dingmao day Venus transgressed Well.
s0268.idiomatic: On dingmao day Venus transgressed Well.

s0269.literal: Sixth month, yihai day: fourteen routes including Pingjiang suffered great flood; two hundred thousand shi of grain was distributed for relief sale according to local prices.
s0269.idiomatic: Sixth month, yihai day: 14 routes including Pingjiang suffered great flood; 200,000 shi of grain was distributed for relief sale according to local prices.

s0270.literal: The estuary at Kunyang Prefecture in Zhongqing Route was opened.
s0270.idiomatic: The estuary at Kunyang Prefecture in Zhongqing Route was opened.

s0271.literal: On jiashen day Jupiter transgressed Office of Strangeness.
s0271.idiomatic: On jiashen day Jupiter transgressed Office of Strangeness.

s0272.literal: On bingxu day Song Longji led four thousand barbarians of Mao, Lao, and Zijiang to attack Yang Huang Stockade, killing and plundering a great many.
s0272.idiomatic: On bingxu day Song Longji led 4,000 barbarians of Mao, Lao, and Zijiang to attack Yang Huang Stockade, killing and plundering a great many.

s0273.literal: On jichou day the king of Burma sent envoys presenting nine tame elephants.
s0273.idiomatic: On jichou day the king of Burma sent envoys presenting nine tame elephants.

s0274.literal: On renchen day Song Longji attacked Guizhou; prefect Zhang Huaide died in battle.
s0274.idiomatic: On renchen day Song Longji attacked Guizhou; prefect Zhang Huaide died in battle.

s0275.literal: Prince Liang sent Zhuangwu'er, branch secretariat grand councillor of Yunnan, and Vice Director Bulanxi with troops to resist them; they killed the rebel chief Sayue and took five hundred heads.
s0275.idiomatic: Prince Liang sent Zhuangwu'er, branch secretariat grand councillor of Yunnan, and Vice Director Bulanxi with troops to resist them; they killed the rebel chief Sayue and took 500 heads.

s0276.literal: On guisi day Venus transgressed Ghost, and Jupiter transgressed Well.
s0276.idiomatic: On guisi day Venus transgressed Ghost, and Jupiter transgressed Well.

s0277.literal: On jiawu day Venus transgressed Ghost.
s0277.idiomatic: On jiawu day Venus transgressed Ghost.

s0278.literal: Prince Nian Bulie's consort Zhahu'er Zhen's households were granted two hundred thousand ingots of paper money.
s0278.idiomatic: Prince Nian Bulie's consort Zhahu'er Zhen's households were granted 200,000 ingots of paper money.

s0279.literal: This month, Bianliang, Nanyang, Weihui, Daming, and Puzhou suffered drought; Dadu Route suffered flood; Shunde and Huaimeng suffered locusts.
s0279.idiomatic: This month, Bianliang, Nanyang, Weihui, Daming, and Puzhou suffered drought; Dadu Route suffered flood; Shunde and Huaimeng suffered locusts.

s0280.literal: Autumn, seventh month, wuxu day, new moon: the day was dark at noon; a violent wind rose from the northeast and rain with hail broke out together; rivers and lakes overflowed, from Tong, Tai, and Chongming in the east to Zhen Prefecture in the west; the people killed in the disaster were beyond counting; more than eighty-seven thousand shi of rice was distributed in relief.
s0280.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, wuxu day, new moon: the day was dark at noon; a violent wind rose from the northeast and rain with hail broke out together; rivers and lakes overflowed, from Tong, Tai, and Chongming in the east to Zhen Prefecture in the west; the people killed in the disaster were beyond counting; more than 87,000 shi of rice was distributed in relief.

s0281.literal: On jihai day garrison troops were increased in Jie and Sha prefectures.
s0281.idiomatic: On jihai day garrison troops were increased in Jie and Sha prefectures.

s0282.literal: On gengzi day more than four hundred households of fields and relay stations seized by Prince Anxi were registered as commoners; Prince Ningyuan Kuokuochu's households were granted twenty-three thousand-odd ingots of paper money.
s0282.idiomatic: On gengzi day more than 400 households of fields and relay stations seized by Prince Anxi were registered as commoners; Prince Ningyuan Kuokuochu's households were granted 23,000-odd ingots of paper money.

s0283.literal: On yisi day Daning Route in Liaoyang Province suffered flood; one thousand shi of grain was distributed in relief.
s0283.idiomatic: On yisi day Daning Route in Liaoyang Province suffered flood; 1,000 shi of grain was distributed in relief.

s0284.literal: On bingwu day Jupiter transgressed Well.
s0284.idiomatic: On bingwu day Jupiter transgressed Well.

s0285.literal: On dingwei day Censor-in-Chief Tugh Temür was ordered to rectify censorate affairs.
s0285.idiomatic: On dingwei day Censor-in-Chief Tugh Temür was ordered to rectify censorate affairs.

s0286.literal: An edict said that military officers who accepted bribes would be treated the same as civilian officials, with demotion and dismissal according to the severity of the crime.
s0286.idiomatic: An edict said that military officers who accepted bribes would be treated the same as civilian officials, with demotion and dismissal according to the severity of the crime.

s0287.literal: Investigating censors were ordered to review and confirm the cases of Jalughachi prisoners and examine the files of the Mongol Hanlin Academy.
s0287.idiomatic: Investigating censors were ordered to review and confirm the cases of Jalughachi prisoners and examine the files of the Mongol Hanlin Academy.

s0288.literal: On wushen day the Tamna military-civilian ten-thousand-household office was established.
s0288.idiomatic: On wushen day the Tamna military-civilian ten-thousand-household office was established.

s0289.literal: Prince Yemegan died; his son Babala succeeded.
s0289.idiomatic: Prince Yemegan died; his son Babala succeeded.

s0290.literal: On jiyou day an edict ordered all offices strictly to forbid bandits and thieves.
s0290.idiomatic: On jiyou day an edict ordered all offices strictly to forbid bandits and thieves.

s0291.literal: On xinhai day the Moon transgressed Encampment.
s0291.idiomatic: On xinhai day the Moon transgressed Encampment.

s0292.literal: Prince Chubo's households and others were granted sixty thousand ingots of paper money, and thirty-eight thousand four hundred ingots were additionally granted for purchasing horses.
s0292.idiomatic: Prince Chubo's households and others were granted 60,000 ingots of paper money, and 38,400 ingots were additionally granted for purchasing horses.

s0293.literal: On guichou day an edict forbade Uyghur monks, yin-yang masters, shamans, Daoists, and incantation masters; from now on any grand rite of prayer must be requested before proceeding, and violators would be punished.
s0293.idiomatic: On guichou day an edict forbade Uyghur monks, yin-yang masters, shamans, Daoists, and incantation masters; from now on any grand rite of prayer must be requested before proceeding, and violators would be punished.

s0294.literal: Accumulated rain in Western Zhejiang overflowed and greatly damaged the people's fields; an edict mobilized two thousand corvée laborers to dredge the river channels so they might return to their former condition.
s0294.idiomatic: Accumulated rain in Western Zhejiang overflowed and greatly damaged the people's fields; an edict mobilized 2,000 corvée laborers to dredge the river channels so they might return to their former condition.

s0295.literal: Yunnan Province was ordered to dispatch Mongol archers to campaign against Babai Xifu.
s0295.idiomatic: Yunnan Province was ordered to dispatch Mongol archers to campaign against Babai Xifu.

s0296.literal: On gengshen day Mercury transgressed Venus.
s0296.idiomatic: On gengshen day Mercury transgressed Venus.

s0297.literal: On guihai day Hedan's grandson Toghon returned from the northern frontier; his parents, wife, and children had all been killed or captured; he was granted one thousand four hundred ingots of paper money.
s0297.idiomatic: On guihai day Hedan's grandson Toghon returned from the northern frontier; his parents, wife, and children had all been killed or captured; he was granted 1,400 ingots of paper money.

s0298.literal: Four hundred thousand ingots of paper money were granted to Prince Consort Zhahu'er Zhen and Prince Chubo's army.
s0298.idiomatic: 400,000 ingots of paper money were granted to Prince Consort Zhahu'er Zhen and Prince Chubo's army.

s0299.literal: Central secretariat officials said, "Under the old regulations, arresting thieves in the capital's prefectures and counties was handled only by the army and horse office; the relevant offices were not involved, and thus delays occurred.
s0299.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said, "Under the old regulations, arresting thieves in the capital's prefectures and counties was handled only by the army and horse office; the relevant offices were not involved, and thus delays occurred.

s0300.literal: From now on we ask that minor offenses be decided and dispatched by the relevant offices, and serious ones be adjudicated by the imperial clan court, so that cases may not remain in prison and the people may not suffer injustice.
s0300.idiomatic: From now on we ask that minor offenses be decided and dispatched by the relevant offices, and serious ones be adjudicated by the imperial clan court, so that cases may not remain in prison and the people may not suffer injustice.
